title: Use text views for long, editable, or specially formatted text

statement.en: Use a text view for long, editable, or specially formatted text.
statement.ja: long、editable、またはspecially formattedなtextにはtext viewを使う。

conditions: A text view offers more specialized display and input options than a label or text field.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Text views experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるText viewsの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。

conditions: People are editing the text view; select a keyboard type designed for the input to streamline entry.
